== Notes ==
* Air of Enchantment reduces the energy cost of all enchantments, both targeted and self-targeting.
** This includes self-targeting enchantments such as [[Flash Enchantments]] and [[Attunements]].
** Party wide enchantments that do not target an ally (such as [[Aegis]] and [[Orders]] enchantments) will have their energy cost reduced if used by the recipient of Air of Enchantment.
** [[Doublecast]] Enchantment Spells are affected only if the target is under Air of Enchantment, not the caster, even though the caster also becomes enchanted when the skill activation completes.
** The cost of [[Enchantment spell#Characteristics|enchantments that target a foe]] is reduced if the target is under Air of Enchantment, not the caster.

== Trivia ==
* During the [[Factions]] beta, this skill was called '''Serenity'''.
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[{{PAGENAME}}/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
